about.title: About
bio: I studied Graphic Design at Universidad Nacional de Cuyo and trained in UX/UI (Coderhouse and Codo a Codo). For 5+ years I have designed for public institutions, companies and agencies: ISCAMEN, Grupo Nexia and Sette Agency, and brands such as MoonDesk, Condimento, Carpa, RLB and Interlink.
I work closely with teams, from brief to final delivery, and use AI to produce faster without giving up design judgement.
